body:
Picture this: You’re driving peacefully in traffic, and suddenly - BAM! Someone rear-ends your car.

Before you even unbuckle your seatbelt, the other driver is out of their car, shouting, blaming you for "sudden braking," and demanding money. Without proof, it’s your word against theirs.

Why leave your hard-earned car and peace of mind to guesswork?

Meet the Qubo Dashcam Pro 2K (Front + Rear). Backed by the Trust of Hero Group, it acts as your unbiased, 24/7 eyewitness recording every second of your drive.

🎥 Dual 2K + 1080P HD Vision: Ultra-clear 2K front camera and 1080P rear camera capture license plates cleanly from both ends.

💥 Instant G-Sensor Lock: Automatically detects impacts or sudden jolts and secures the video so it can't be overwritten.

☀️ Built For Extreme Heat: Powered by a heat-resilient Supercapacitor (no dangerous lithium batteries) designed for Indian weather.

🔄 360° Rotatable Design: Rotate to monitor the cabin or street view instantly.

Don’t wait for a costly road dispute to wish you had one.

👉 Limited-Time Deal: Get yours for ₹6,490!
